journal.text: Quill agreed to ninety up front.
Quill hired you to lift Mara Voss's unedited hour from Glass Chapel.
The choir door accepted a name you kept on a chip.
Mara Voss signed the Ward Nine coolant dump. Three hundred people, one memo.
A second copy of Mara's hour exists.
Mara authorizes the flush. She says the tower promised an evacuation. The signature proves authorization; her explanation still needs corroboration.
The exported receipt records an instruction canceling evacuation while retaining the flush. Its contents are visible; the issuing key still needs independent verification during The Week.
Ivo Pell and Junie Calder were on shift. Nia Pell signed the housing slip and reached a service exit. She can corroborate the receipt, but a public roster would expose where she sleeps.
The signature and the later evacuation cancellation are separate decisions. Mara's prior knowledge and the receipt's issuer remain questions, not acquittals.
The packet accuses Helion of canceling evacuation before the issuing key is authenticated. The allegation is not independent proof.
Trace the tower receipt to corroborate Mara's hour.
Quill supplied a Archive Probe for 140 creds from the district repair bench. Its uses are specific; it reserves no witness room.
You took a short rest beside the canal. Pressure eased. The visit moved no witness, authenticated no evidence, and erased no exposed record.
Catalog locator WN/SHIFT/REV identifies a possible independent ledger for the evacuation revision. The logged lookup retrieved no record and authenticated no issuing key.

A staffed extraction at WN/SHIFT/REV corroborates the evacuation cancellation. You paid twenty-five creds for the search. No reader authenticated the digital issuing key; custody and source-name permission remain separate.

A staffed search retrieved the shift-ledger extraction at WN/SHIFT/REV. It independently corroborates the evacuation cancellation while the flush remained scheduled. No reader authenticated the digital issuing key.
Sera holds the source original and ledger reference. The circulating copy withholds Edda's name; any employer trace on the extraction remains.
You promised to collect Kerr's own unpowered brace without entering him on the depot recipient register. Delivery and treatment are separate outcomes.
Departed through courier gate toward patrol gap. Spent 0 creds and took 0 planned strain. The gate recorded the runner's handle and Kerr as recipient.
Kerr received his closed brace case. The depot recipient register broke the promised private terms. No fitting, treatment result, historical evidence or witness permission was supplied.

You signed a public request to review the canal depot recipient register. The depot closed its anonymous side hatch during review and retained a registered main counter. No technician or witness identity was attached; the review is not a finding.
